title: Do MLLMs Really Understand Low-Resource Khmer Documents? A Pilot Study on Khmer Document VQA
abstract: arXiv:2608.28635v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced document understanding, visual question answering, and text extraction. However, their reliability in low-resource, non-Latin settings remains uncertain. Khmer form documents present particular challenges because they contain complex script forms, mixed Khmer-English fields, and monetary values in both Cambodian Riel and US Dollars. Available resources for Khmer Document VQA are also limited. This paper presents a pilot diagnostic evaluation of open MLLMs on Khmer document images. We construct an evaluation subset from the previously introduced KH-FUNSD collection, covering invoices, receipts, quotations, and other business forms. The subset includes questions in English and Khmer, with answers retained in their original English, Khmer, mixed-script, or numeric forms. translated_title: 多模态大语言模型真的理解低资源高棉语文档吗？高棉语文档视觉问答的初步研究
translated_abstract: 近年来，多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在文档理解、视觉问答和文本提取方面取得了显著进展。然而，它们在低资源、非拉丁字母环境下的可靠性仍不确定。高棉语表单文档带来了特殊的挑战，因为它们包含复杂的文字形式、高棉语与英语混合的字段，以及以柬埔寨瑞尔和美元两种货币计价的金额。此外，可用于高棉语文档视觉问答的资源也十分有限。本文对开放的多模态大语言模型在高棉语文档图像上进行了初步的诊断性评估。我们从先前提出的KH-FUNSD集合中构建了一个评估子集，涵盖发票、收据、报价单和其他商业表单。该子集包含英语和高棉语的问题，答案保留其原始的英语、高棉语、混合文字或数字形式。本研究并非引入完整的公开基准，而是考察了开放多模态大语言模型的能力与失败模式。
tldr: 本文基于KH-FUNSD集合构建评估子集，对开放多模态大语言模型在高棉语表单文档视觉问答任务上的能力与失败模式进行了初步诊断性评估，揭示了其在低资源非拉丁字母环境下的表现局限。
en_tdlr: This pilot study conducts a diagnostic evaluation of open MLLMs on Khmer Document VQA using an evaluation subset built from the KH-FUNSD collection, examining their capabilities and failure modes in low-resource, non-Latin settings.
